request: Analyze GSE324100 for PMID 42241015 (Exercise training prior to and during cancer in mice preserves muscle mass, reduces tumour weight and suppresses molecular mediators of cachexia.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk total RNA-seq, gastrocnemius, BALB/c mice (S2.7.p1)

intervention: PoWeR (progressive weighted wheel running, ~11.5-12 wk, 8 wk before and 3.5 wk after C26 inoculation)

final.sample_inclusion: subset of n = 2-3 mice per sex per group chosen to represent group averages (S2.7.p1); FIG8 legend: PBS SED n=6, PBS PoWeR n=6, C26 SED n=5, C26 PoWeR n=5; sexes collapsed (S2.8.p1, S3.7.p1)
final.primary_estimand: effect of PoWeR training on gastrocnemius gene expression in healthy mice (PBS PoWeR vs PBS SED) and in tumour-bearing mice (C26 PoWeR vs C26 SED); tumour effect C26 SED vs PBS SED as context
planned_contrasts: PBS PoWeR vs PBS SED (S3.7.p1; paper: 42 DEGs)
C26 SED vs PBS SED (S3.7.p1; paper: 2740 DEGs)
C26 PoWeR vs C26 SED (S3.7.p1; paper: 963 DEGs)
final.repeated_measure_unit: none; one gastrocnemius per independent mouse
final.normalization: DESeq2 median ratio after excluding genes with max count < 5 (S2.7.p1)
final.paper_method: DESeq2 in Partek Flow, sexes pooled, genes with geometric mean < 1 excluded before BH correction (S2.7.p1)

design.reasoning: Paper compares the four tumour x intervention cells pairwise with sexes pooled (S3.7.p1, S2.8.p1). One model on all 22 samples with planned pairwise contrasts, never pooled levels. Exercise contrasts within PBS and within C26 are primary; the tumour effect is secondary context.
